title: Agents collects a cross-platform marketplace of agent skills and plugins
friendlyTitle: Agents shares reusable skills for many coding assistants
summary: The Agents repository is a rapidly updated, MIT-licensed marketplace of agent plugins and skills for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot, Google Antigravity and Pi. It has about 40,000 stars and includes specialist workflows, multi-agent patterns and evaluation tooling.
friendlySummary: This popular repository collects plugins and specialist instructions that work across several coding-agent tools. It has about 40,000 GitHub stars and is being updated actively.
whyItMatters: Builders can study reusable skill structures or adapt reviewed components across several coding-agent harnesses instead of maintaining separate collections. Plugins expand an agent’s instructions and capabilities, so inspect sources and permissions before installing them in sensitive repositories.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it to learn how agent skills are organized or reuse a suitable workflow. Read the files first, because a plugin can change what an agent is allowed or instructed to do.
